proposal.title: Feasible intersection or separation certificate
proposal.obligation: For nonempty closed integer intervals, return either a common witness or a valid certificate b<c or d<a, with exhaustive and mutually sound outcomes.
targeted_negative_controls: Return a witness in only one interval
Return failure without a separation certificate
proposal.diversity_rationale: Constructive positive result plus a negative certificate; not just additional separated witnesses.

logical_delta: The earlier intersection task assumes overlap, and exact-gap pair assumes feasible translated intervals. This instance requires exhaustive positive and negative certificate branches from only nonempty input intervals; touching remains a positive witness case.
overlap_with_ancestors: The overlap branch still uses max lower/min upper endpoints and opaque membership packaging from the known witness lineage. Providers and arithmetic case splits are related, so this is a new obligation within an inspected development family.
output_scope: Ghost proof certificates are returned by immutable client lemmas. No executable decision/search procedure, causal sharing effect, model difficulty or minimal proof-depth claim.
